SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.RDCNT),0) AS statsCo
, SUBSTR(a.OCCRRNC_DE, 1, 4) AS statsDate
, CONCAT(CONCAT(SUBSTR(a.OCCRRNC_DE, 1, 4), '-'), SUBSTR(a.OCCRRNC_DE, 5, 2)) AS statsDate
, CONCAT(CONCAT(CONCAT(CONCAT(SUBSTR(a.OCCRRNC_DE, 1, 4), '-'), SUBSTR(a.OCCRRNC_DE, 5, 2)), '-'), SUBSTR(a.OCCRRNC_DE, 7, 2)) AS statsDate
FROM SWEBLOGSUMMARY a, (SELECT PROGRM_STRE_PATH AS URL FROM NPROGRMLIST WHERE PROGRM_FILE_NM = #{detailStatsKind}) b WHERE 1 = 1
AND a.OCCRRNC_DE BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} AND POSITION(b.URL IN a.URL) > 0 GROUP BY statsDate ORDER BY statsDate
